tagline: Strength training that fits your week.
description: StayFit Studio is a strength training app that builds a personal workout plan around the time and equipment you actually have. Short guided sessions, progress tracking and a coach who adjusts your plan every week.
features: Personal workout plan built around your schedule
20 to 40 minute guided sessions with video demos
Works with dumbbells, bands or bodyweight only
Weekly check-ins with a certified coach
Progress tracking for strength, streaks and body measurements
audiences: Busy parents with 30 minutes a day
Beginners who have never lifted weights
